replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
This map looks awesome for a 5v5!

Usually, Cacalmarin has nobody to scrim, or we only have small scrims. This map is perfect for that. 

However, purely because of the size I feel that this is not fit for the tournament. If you make it a bit bigger, I will change my opinion on this.
